scopes.label: Read calendars
scopes.description: Read events in every calendar in the tenant.

scopes.label: Read presence
scopes.description: Read every user's presence: available, busy or away.

scopes.label: Read and write calendars
scopes.description: Create, change and delete events in every calendar in the tenant.
scopes.risk: The app can change or delete anyone's meetings, not only read them.

scopes.label: Send mail as any user
scopes.description: Send mail as any user in the tenant.
scopes.risk: The app can send mail that looks as if anyone in the organization wrote it.

scopes.label: Read all files
scopes.description: Read every file in OneDrive and SharePoint.
scopes.risk: The app can read every document in the tenant, sensitive ones included.
